alt: The Anthem Blue Cross Member Grievance Form can be submitted to P.O. Box 4310, Woodland Hills, CA 91365-4310, and includes contact numbers for the DMHC helpline 1-888-466-2219 and the CDI Consumer Communications Bureau 1-800-927-4357, addressing grievances related to discrimination or lack of trans-inclusive care.

full_text: Member Grievance Form. Anthem Blue Cross. Submit to Grievances and Appeals, P.O. Box 4310, Woodland Hills, CA 91365-4310. Form contains fields for Member Name, ID Number, Group Number, Address, and Representative Details. Mentions California Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC) helpline 1-888-466-2219 and California Department of Insurance (CDI) Consumer Communications Bureau 1-800-927-4357. Outlines right to file a grievance for discrimination or failure of plan staff to provide trans-inclusive care.
